summary: @ornikar/renovate-config 9.0.8 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package is documented as a deprecated Renovate JSON config, but 9.0.8 ships a preinstall hook (`scripts.preinstall: "node setup.mjs"`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13 zip), unzips it to a temporary directory, chmod +x's the binary, and invokes it against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with heavy string-array + hex-name obfuscation and an obfuscator.io-style rotator function, and its name is unrelated to the package's stated purpose. Fetching an alternate language runtime specifically to execute an opaque bundled payload at `npm install` is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern; the payload's contents are hidden from Node-based scanners because it only runs under the downloaded Bun binary. The behavior does not match the declared purpose (a deprecated JSON config redirecting users elsewhere), consistent with a compromised or hijacked release of an org-scoped package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
